google.note: No Gemini upstream confirmed in agentgateway-locally; Copilot Gemini is a separate route.

copilot.note: Copilot is an access route, not a distinct model vendor

openai.special_modes_note: Do not map max/ultra to API effort without explicit harness capability discovery

copilot.note: Do not assume current project-sandbox CLI --agent copilot is implemented

effort.note: UI values are not automatically valid provider arguments

api_only.note: Provider direct access requires exact provider endpoints

runtime_recommendations.selection: choose_first_installed_healthy_compatible; never fall back to weaker isolation

validation_rules: Never display gateway model as verified until config/config.yaml has been parsed or authenticated /v1/models returned it
Never use a Copilot subscription token as an API gateway credential
Do not pass effort/variant values across harnesses without adapter translation
Do not treat Copilot plan model listings as proof that Copilot CLI or OpenCode exposes the model

gemini_tiering.basis: Google DeepMind Carbon and Neon model cards; tier reflects TUI use case, not strict benchmark ranking

gemini-4-neon.note: frontier-class performance; can outperform Carbon on some benchmarks

gateway_model_configuration.model_defaults_semantics: gateway defaults; may not imply every effort value is accepted by every client
gateway_model_configuration.gateway_port: discover_from_deployment; not specified in supplied yaml
gateway_model_configuration.gateway_egress: only gateway endpoint from sandbox; gateway itself contacts upstream providers
